headline: Currency mismatch clouds the year-over-year comparison
summary_short: B3 reported Q2 FY2026 ADR EPS of $0.16; the shard's prior-period EPS figures are BRL-denominated.
summary_long: Current-period EPS of $0.16 is USD-denominated (ADR-level), while the shard's prior-quarter (R$0.88) and year-ago (R$0.76) EPS figures are BRL-denominated. No like-for-like delta could be computed across the currency mismatch. No revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed for this period.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Current-period EPS (USD, ADR) and shard prior-period EPS (BRL) are on different currency bases; no y/y or q/q delta is reported to avoid a meaningless cross-currency percentage.
